title: Unbounded polyphony: maxSamples is stored but never enforced in doPlay
description:
In MxSamplezInstrument.sc, maxSamples is accepted as a constructor arg and stored (line 39) but never referenced in doPlay (line 483). Every note_on spawns a new Synth with no cap. With a 5s default release, synths accumulate rapidly. With 2+ instruments loaded, the pile doubles and causes CPU overload/crash.

Fix: before spawning a new Synth in doPlay, count total active voices across all notes in the syn dict and voice-steal the oldest if count >= maxSamples.
close_reason: Implemented voice-steal block in doPlay. Counts total active voices across all notes in the syn dict before spawning a new Synth. When at or over maxSamples (100), kills the first available voice with a 0.05s release. Safety exit prevents infinite loop if syn dict is unexpectedly empty.

title: Default release time of 5s causes synth accumulation
description:
MxSamplezInstrument.sc line 62 sets the default release to 5.0 seconds. With high note density (4 tracks at 1/16th division), every note played in the last 5 seconds is still consuming CPU. This compounds directly with the missing polyphony cap (pitter-patter-2zr).

Fix: reduce default release to 1.0 or 2.0 seconds. This alone cuts the maximum synth accumulation window by 60-80%.
close_reason: Reduced default release from 5.0 to 2.0 seconds. Cuts the maximum synth accumulation window by 60%. Still long enough for natural decay on most samples.

title: NodeWatcher.register called on every note — expensive OSC polling overhead
description:
MxSamplezInstrument.sc line 512 calls NodeWatcher.register(node, true) on every single note played. NodeWatcher sends periodic /n_query OSC messages to poll whether each node is alive. With multiple instruments and high note density the OSC overhead scales with total playing voices.

The onFree callback (same doPlay block) already handles removing nodes from the syn dict, making NodeWatcher redundant. The isRunning/isPlaying guards in noteOff and noteFade (lines 449-451, 471-472) will still evaluate correctly without it.

Fix: remove the NodeWatcher.register line.
close_reason: Removed NodeWatcher.register(node, true) from doPlay. The onFree callback already handles syn dict cleanup; NodeWatcher was only needed to support isRunning/isPlaying checks which remain functional as guards.

title: mxfx reverb uses 32 CombN + 10 AllpassN — too expensive for Norns hardware
close_reason: Replaced 32 CombN + SplayAz + 5x AllpassN reverb with FreeVerb2.ar — a single native UGen. Also restored the missing reverb level multiplier (* reverb) that was absent in the original.
